name: Local Thickness Mapping and Analysis
description:
Perform a local thickness analysis on the 'Blobs' sample image to characterize structural width.

1. Open the 'Blobs (25K)' sample image (File > Open Samples > Blobs (25K)).
2. Create a binary mask of the objects (Image > Adjust > Threshold).
3. Compute the local thickness map using the Local Thickness plugin (Plugins > Local Thickness > Local Thickness (complete process)).
   - Note: The output should be a 32-bit heatmap image where pixel values represent thickness (diameter).
4. Save this thickness map to `~/ImageJ_Data/results/thickness_map.tif`.
5. Analyze the thickness statistics (e.g., using Analyze > Histogram on the thickness map) and save a CSV file containing the summary statistics (Mean, StdDev, Min, Max) to `~/ImageJ_Data/results/thickness_distribution.csv`.
